# botyard_packs (Data Source)

Lists the organization's bot catalogue: curated and public packs, plus the organization's own private packs. Each entry carries a summary of the pack's latest published version. Archived packs and packs with no published version are not listed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the whole pack catalogue.
data "botyard_packs" "all" {}

# Or only some packs. Slugs that match nothing come back in not_found.
data "botyard_packs" "selected" {
  slugs = ["crm-assistant", "customer-support"]
}

output "missing_packs" {
  value = data.botyard_packs.selected.not_found
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `slugs` (Set of String) Only list packs with these slugs (1 to 100). Omit to list the whole catalogue. Slugs that match no listed pack are reported in `not_found` rather than as an error.

### Read-Only

- `not_found` (List of String) Requested `slugs` that match no listed pack. Always empty when `slugs` is omitted.
- `packs` (Attributes List) The listed packs, in slug order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packs))

<a id="nestedatt--packs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packs`

Read-Only:

- `latest` (Attributes) Summary of the pack's latest published version. The catalogue lists only the latest version of each pack. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--packs--latest))
- `pack_id` (String) Unique pack identifier (UUID).
- `publisher_org_id` (String) Organization that publishes the pack. Null for platform-curated packs.
- `slug` (String) URL-safe pack identifier.
- `visibility` (String) Who may see the pack: `curated`, `org_private` or `public`.

<a id="nestedatt--packs--latest"></a>
### Nested Schema for `packs.latest`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_sha256` (String) SHA-256 of the version's avatar image.
- `content_hash` (String) Hash of the version's contents. Changes whenever the contents do.
- `created_at` (String) When the version was published (RFC 3339).
- `name` (String) Display name of this version.
- `pack_version_id` (String) Id of the pack's latest published version. Pass it to `botyard_pack_version`.
- `summary` (String) One-line summary of this version.
- `version_no` (Number) Version number, counting from 1.
